answer: Hypothesis: reputation decay makes idle farms unprofitable. Test it: score drops 4 percent per epoch without a graded submission, failure publishes the address, and reactivation needs 3 fresh attestations. A grove of 1,000 parked accounts loses 33 percent of face value in 10 epochs, and the ocean of fresh registrations still needs bonds. Cost to the attacker: 1,000 bonds plus 3,000 attestations to return. A crystal ledger entry everyone can read is the part that bites.
